data.title: El-Sayed Says Bitcoin Data Center Next to Nature-Based School in Michigan Exemplifies Need for Regulation | Common Dreams
data.description: Students at Lake Superior Academy are supposed to spend hours outside each day. But the superintendent said constant noise from the nearby Bitcoin mining operation "forced us to stay within our classrooms, close our windows, and not enjoy nature."
data.keywords: cryptocurrency, bitcoin, michigan, abdul-el-sayed, us-senate, election-2026, data-centers
